data.nature: AtCoder Problems community IRT estimates; not AtCoder-native; not republished
data.outlier_rule: difficulty < -2000 is treated as unknown (sentinel); next lowest observed value is -1438

formula_source.note: Formulas reimplemented from reading; no source code copied.

findings.raw_vs_display: JSON field `difficulty` is raw. The frontend sets rawDifficulty = model.difficulty and difficulty = clipDifficulty(model.difficulty) (APIClient.ts). Negative values in the snapshot confirm the JSON is unclipped.
findings.display_clip: clipDifficulty(d) = d >= 400 ? d : 400 / exp(1 - d/400)  (display only)
findings.internal_rating: n = rated participations; r' = rating <= 400 ? 400 * (1 - ln(400/rating)) : rating; internal = r' + ((sqrt(1 - 0.9^(2n)) / (1 - 0.9^n) - 1) / (sqrt(19) - 1)) * 1200; null when n = 0  (RatingInfo.ts)
findings.condition: Model predicts contest-time solving by rated participants, not untimed practice.
findings.single_slope: All models share one discrimination, so the model is a one-parameter logistic with slope 1/223.24 per rating point.

design_deviation: design.md section 4 planned a Laplace update over per-problem discrimination. Because discrimination is constant, the learner update uses the same logistic with a conservative Elo-style step and an explicit uncertainty SD; practice ability stays separate from contest internal rating.
acceptance: JS implementation equals an independent Python evaluation of the cited formulas within 1e-12 on 5 sampled tasks (hosted/test/calibration.test.mjs fixture).
